response.overview: Stigmatized since childhood by her love of the rock band Journey, Maya finds her voice in a world where she doesn't always feel "Black enough". Out of Tune is a charming and uplifting concept short centering a proud Black woman who gets a second chance at performing in front of people and defining her identity in her own terms. From adolescent to adulthood, Maya navigates the boundaries of racial identity and her love for the band Journey. Slowly freeing herself from having "something to hide" to understanding she has "nothing to prove."
response.title: Out of Tune
